verdict.rationale: Asana publishes an official OpenAPI specification repository (Asana/openapi) containing YAML spec files for both the REST API and app components, which is machine-readable and downloadable, and docs also mention a built-in API explorer per endpoint. Missing for 10: the spec isn't hosted at a standard discoverable endpoint on developers.asana.com itself (probe found 404s at common openapi.json paths), requiring users to know to find it via GitHub rather than a documented direct download link.
